report: Checkout is returning 502s for every customer since the 14:05 deploy. Stripe webhooks are piling up and we're losing orders right now.
The nightly CSV export has been silently dropping rows for three customers since yesterday's release. The totals in their finance reports are wrong.
The dashboard chart legend overlaps the axis labels in Safari 17. Cosmetic, nobody is blocked.
Twelve failed login attempts from an unknown IP on an admin account at 03:10, then a successful login and a bulk download of the customer list.
Staging deploys take 20 minutes today instead of 5. Not blocking anyone, just annoying.
Invoices for annual plans show the monthly price. Customers are emailing to ask which amount they'll be charged.
api.example.com is down for everyone. DNS isn't resolving from three regions. Started about ten minutes ago.
Search takes 8 to 10 seconds in large workspaces. Users can still work; adding a filter brings it back to normal.
After we rolled out the new password policy, SSO users on the old token format get a 401 on every request. Enterprise customers are locked out.
The weekly usage report emailed to workspace admins covers the wrong week, for the second week running. The numbers themselves are right.
Our internal admin tool shows a yellow status banner instead of green after the theme update. Purely visual.
Webhook deliveries to one customer's endpoint are timing out intermittently. Their integration retries, so they see a delay of a few minutes.
A customer restored a deleted project and the restore overwrote the project they had created since. Two days of their work are gone.
The signup page is a blank screen in Firefox since this morning's frontend release. Chrome is fine. New customers on Firefox can't sign up.
Monthly invoice PDFs are being generated with the previous customer's billing address on them. Two customers have noticed so far.
The metrics pipeline is 40 minutes behind. Dashboards show stale numbers, but nothing is lost and it will catch up on its own.
Kubernetes nodes in eu-west are at 95% memory. No errors yet, but another traffic spike will start evicting pods.
The Export to PDF button does nothing on the reports page. Users can still export the same report as CSV.
A contractor's API token is still valid three weeks after their contract ended. There is no sign it has been used.
Retries for failed card payments are charging customers twice. 40 duplicate charges in the last hour and climbing.
